purpose: Local observability packet for seeing agent coding work, touched modules, review focus, and safety gates in near real time without sending telemetry anywhere.

module_map.review_hint: architecture clarity, safety language, next-step usefulness
token reduction, safe handoff, schema readability
scene memory, visible-state accuracy, JSON validity
accessible controls, local-only state, responsive layout
storage safety, event wiring, syntax, audit behavior

review_focus_rules.focus: new untracked file: confirm it should be committed or ignored
modified file: review diff and run relevant checks
added file: verify scope, safety, and docs
deleted file: confirm removal is intentional
renamed file: verify references and links

residual_trace: Espresso should feel like watching warm work lights turn on across the workshop: clear enough to review, gentle enough not to surveil the soul.
